commands.usage: dacli accept <ref> [--verify "cmd"] [--full-output] [--final-commit SHA --final-tree SHA] [--require-verify] [--require-independent] [--allow-unverified] [--allow-unlanded] [--allow-unobservable-check-policy] [--defer-landing] [--force] [--into BRANCH] | dacli accept --all [--verify "cmd"] [--full-output] [--final-commit SHA --final-tree SHA] [--require-verify] [--require-independent] [--allow-unverified] [--allow-unlanded] [--allow-unobservable-check-policy] [--defer-landing] [--force] [--into BRANCH]
dacli auth login --provider URL --tenant ID --name NAME [--json]
dacli auth logout --provider URL --tenant ID --device ID [--json]
dacli auth whoami --provider URL --tenant ID --device ID [--json]
dacli github release <project> <tag> [--title t] [--notes text] [--target ref] [--draft] [--prerelease] [--dry-run]
dacli integrate [--tasks refs] [--project slug] [--pr | --landing-mode local] [--into BRANCH | --landing-base BRANCH] [--auto] [--merge] [--no-merge] [--force]

dacli note add <decision|finding|metric|ref> <title> --project <slug> [--about ref] [--body text] [--rejected text --because text] [--severity major|moderate|minor] [--scope project|workspace] [--origin file:x] [--against agent-id]
dacli project add <title> [--slug s] [--goal g] [--stage definition|elicitation|approach|design] [--landing-mode local|pr] [--landing-base BRANCH]
dacli queue add <slug> --step 'cmd or instruction'... [--title t]
dacli queue advance <slug> [--key id] [--retry reason|--terminal reason|--fail reason]
dacli release train --project SLUG --source BRANCH --target BRANCH (--dry-run | --apply) [--required-check NAME] [--required-artifact NAME] [--required-reviews N] [--merge]
dacli risk add <title> --project <slug> --impact high|medium|low --likelihood high|medium|low [--indicator text]... [--action text]
dacli role add <name> [--runtime rt] [--model-id id] [--cost-tier 1..98] [--max-task-points N] [--context-limit N] [--capability-tag tag]...
dacli run <name> [--<param> value]... [--dry-run] [--confirm] | dacli run --cmd '<command>' [--dry-run] | dacli run --list

dacli ship [--project slug] [--tasks refs] [--pr | --landing-mode local] [--into BRANCH | --landing-base BRANCH] [--verify "cmd"] [--no-accept] [--no-integrate] [--auto] [--merge] [--no-merge] [--record-branch BRANCH] [--push] [--release TAG] [--dry-run]
dacli shortcut add <name> --command 'tmpl {{p}}' --effect read|write|destructive [--summary s] [--param name=default]... [--role r]... [--why text]
dacli shortcut promote <name> --from-event <run-event-id> --effect read|write|destructive [--summary s] [--param name=default]... [--role r]... [--why text]
dacli skill add <name> --desc "trigger description" [--body text] [--min-delivery native|context|inline]
dacli skill fetch <owner/repo>   (from skills.sh, e.g. mattpocock/skills)
dacli stage advance <project> [--key id] [--retry reason|--terminal reason]
dacli taint <origin>   (e.g. file:cron/settle.go, external:someuser, or just file: for all)
dacli task acceptance migrate <ref> [--from-section "Acceptance criteria"] (--dry-run | --apply plan-id)
dacli task add <title> --project <slug> [--priority must|should|could|wont] [--estimate o,m,p] [--accept criterion]... [--so-that why] [--parent ref] [--depends-on ref[:TYPE]]... [--force]
dacli task reopen <ref> --reason "<what makes the close wrong>"
dacli task takeover <ref> --force --reason "why recovery is safe"
